overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the January 4 emails, which brought a quorum onto the chain, were procedural agenda and scheduling communications within the statutory exception, not deliberation.

allegations.summary: Chair and Vice Chair allegedly deliberated by email on Jan 4 outside a posted meeting, adding the clerk so a quorum of members was on the chain.
allegations.key_passage: We do not find that the emails conveyed the Chair’s or Vice Chair’s opinions regarding matters within the Commission’s jurisdiction, but rather were limited to procedural matters related to the preparation and distribution of the agenda and accompanying materials.
